items.title: Travelers (TRV) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Strong Q2 And Split Analyst Views
items.summary: The latest fair value estimate for Travelers Companies has moved from US$320.74 to US$354.71, an adjustment of about 11% that reframes how some analysts think about potential upside in the stock. This shift comes alongside a split in Street research, with more bullish voices pointing to strong Q2 execution and earnings power, while cautious analysts highlight valuation considerations and a softer insurance backdrop.
